review_candidates.title: Responsable de service mandats et instances H/F
review_candidates.description: Unéo recherche un(e) Responsable Mandats et Instances H/F , en contrat à durée indéterminée, au sein de sa Direction du Cabinet et de la Vie institutionnelle , à Montrouge (92). Rattaché(e) à la Directrice du Cabinet et de la Vie institutionnelle, le/la Responsable Mandats et Instances contribue à la préparation et au bon fonctionnement des instances de gouvernance du groupe Unéo, ainsi qu’à l’accompagnement du Président dans l’exercice de ses différents mandats. Il/elle assure également le suivi des dossiers liés à la Mutualité Française et contribue à la coordination des relations avec les autres acteurs mutualistes partenaires d’Unéo. Vos missions : 1. Préparer et assurer le suivi des instances de gouvernance du groupe : Assurer la préparation et le suivi des instances de gouvernance du groupe Unéo, en lien avec les directions et parties prenantes concernées : préparation des ordres du jour, coordination et constitution des dossiers ; Veiller à la bonne articulation des calendriers entre les différentes instances du groupe et les mandats du Président ; Veiller à la qualité, à la cohérence et à la conformité des dossiers préparés à destination du Président, des administrateurs et des membres de la Direction ; Assurer la rédaction des procès-verbaux, comptes rendus et relevés de décisions, ainsi que leur circuit de relecture et de validation. 2. Contribuer à la préparation des mandats et rendez-vous du Président Préparer les dossiers nécessaires à l’exercice des différents mandats du Président et à ses principaux rendez-vous, en lien avec les parties prenantes concernées : analyse des sujets, identification des enjeux et points d’attention, élaboration de notes de synthèse, éléments de langage et supports préparatoires ; Contribuer à la préparation des rencontres institutionnelles et aux projets transverses portés par la Direction du Cabinet et de la Vie institutionnelle. 3. Assurer le suivi des dossiers de la Mutualité Française Préparer les dossiers du Président relatifs aux instances de la Fédération nationale de la Mutualité Française (FNMF) auxquelles il participe, en analysant les sujets inscrits à l’ordre du jour et en élaborant les notes de synthèse, éléments de langage et points d’attention nécessaires ; Assurer le suivi des dossiers et travaux portés par la FNMF, au-delà des seules instances, afin d’identifier les sujets présentant un intérêt ou un enjeu pour Unéo ; Participer, pour le compte d’Unéo, à certains groupes de travail et réunions de la FNMF, en assurer la restitution et le suivi ; Contribuer à la bonne circulation de l’information relative aux travaux de la FNMF auprès de la Directrice du Cabinet et de la Vie institutionnelle et des interlocuteurs internes concernés. 4. Contribuer à la coordination avec les autres acteurs mutualistes Contribuer à la coordination avec les autres membres d’Affinitaire et Solidaire, en lien avec le pôle de coordination mutualiste, et assurer la bonne circulation des informations et documents utiles ; Faciliter la coordination entre les élus des différentes mutuelles membres et contribuer à la préparation et au suivi des travaux menés en commun. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Chez Unéo, nous ne sommes pas seulement dédiés à offrir une protection en santé et en prévoyance de qualité à nos adhérents, nous croyons aussi que nos collaborateurs méritent une expérience de travail de qualité. Développement Personnel et Professionnel : Nous croyons en votre potentiel. Nous offrons des formations continues, des opportunités d'avancement, et un environnement propice à l'apprentissage et à la croissance. Politique sociale avantageuse : CSE, tickets restaurants, une participation aux frais de transport de 75%, de chèques CESU pour la garde d’enfants, … Equilibre vie professionnelle, vie personnelle : Chez Unéo nous offrons des horaires flexibles, du télétravail jusqu’à 2 jours par semaine après l’acquisition de toutes les formations et une autonomie complète, … Bien-être au travail : Votre bien-être est notre priorité. Profitez d’un environnement de travail agréable. Actions de prévention … mais aussi salle de sport, rooftop Solidarité, respect et équité sont les maitres mots qui animent la mission d’Unéo depuis 130 ans : protéger ceux qui ont fait le choix de protéger les autres. Acteur engagé et responsable Unéo, œuvre à la protection de ses assurés et au bien-être de la communauté défense dans son ensemble au travers des actions de solidarité et de soutien aux associations défense tout au long de l’année. La mutuelle s’est engagée dans une démarche responsable afin de construire une protection sociale durable. Profil : Titulaire d’un diplôme de niveau Bac+5, vous justifiez d’au moins 5 ans d’expérience sur des fonctions similaires, idéalement au sein d’une mutuelle, d’une fédération professionnelle, d’un organisme de protection sociale ou dans un environnement institutionnel comparable. Vous disposez d’une bonne connaissance de l’environnement mutualiste et de son fonctionnement. Une connaissance de la Mutualité Française, de ses instances et de ses principaux acteurs serait particulièrement appréciée. Une connaissance complémentaire de l’environnement institutionnel, des ministères et/ou du monde de la Défense constitue également un atout. Vous disposez de très bonnes capacités rédactionnelles, d’analyse et de synthèse. Vous savez vous approprier des dossiers complexes, en identifier les principaux enjeux et produire des documents clairs et structurés à destination de dirigeants et d’élus. Rigoureux(se) et organisé(e), vous savez gérer plusieurs échéances simultanément, anticiper les besoins et travailler avec de nombreux interlocuteurs dans le respect de calendriers contraints. Votre sens de la confidentialité, votre diplomatie et votre discernement vous permettent d’évoluer avec aisance auprès d’interlocuteurs de haut niveau. Autonome dans la conduite de vos missions, dynamique et doté(e) d’un excellent relationnel, vous appréciez le travail transversal et savez adapter votre communication à la diversité de vos interlocuteurs. Vous maîtrisez les outils bureautiques, notamment Word et Excel, et disposez d’une très bonne maîtrise de PowerPoint.

review_candidates.title: Requirement Specialist
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Requirement Specialist Work location: Cairo, Egypt About DBEE : Deliver Egypt’s first High-Speed Rail service with DBEE. DBEE is a joint venture between DB International Operations and Elsewedy Electric. While DB International Operations brings extensive expertise in railway operations and maintenance worldwide, Elsewedy Electric contributes strong capabilities in energy and infrastructure solutions. Together, we combine global railway know-how with local excellence to enable efficient, safe, and sustainable passenger and freight mobility across Egypt’s first high-speed rail network. Join us in shaping this landmark project in Cairo. The role: We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Requirements Specialist to identify, capture, analyze, document, and manage operational and maintenance requirements throughout the railway project lifecycle. The role serves as a key interface between the client, operational stakeholders, maintenance teams, engineering disciplines, and project management to ensure the railway system is designed, delivered, and maintained in accordance with contractual, operational, safety, and regulatory requirements. Working closely with the Project Management, Operations, Technical, Procurement, and Finance teams, you will act as an important interface between the project team, the client, subcontractors, and other external stakeholders. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to a landmark railway project in Egypt within an international and multidisciplinary project environment. Your responsibilities: Collect, review, and analyze contractual, operational, maintenance, safety, and regulatory requirements. Develop, maintain, and manage the project requirements database and requirements traceability matrix. Ensure all contractual requirements are clearly defined, documented, and allocated to the relevant project disciplines. Coordinate regularly with relevant departments to ensure requirements are correctly implemented. Monitor compliance with contractual, regulatory, and railway industry requirements. Manage requirement changes and assess their impact on scope, cost, schedule, and operational performance. Support verification and validation activities to demonstrate that all requirements have been fulfilled. Facilitate stakeholder workshops and reviews to clarify requirements and resolve gaps, inconsistencies, or conflicts. Prepare reports, presentations, and status updates on requirements management activities. Support asset handover, commissioning, and transition into operational service by ensuring operations and maintenance requirements have been adequately addressed. Job qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Railway, Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Systems, Industrial, or Transportation Engineering, or a related technical discipline. A master’s degree in Railway Systems, Transportation Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline is advantageous. Minimum of 5–7 years of relevant professional experience. Knowledge of railway operations and maintenance principles and asset lifecycle management. Familiarity with requirements management methodologies and tools such as DOORS, Jama, Polarion, or similar is an advantage. Strong analytical, stakeholder management, and communication skills. Understanding of systems engineering, configuration management, and verification and validation processes. Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and international project environments. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word and Excel. Fluency in written and spoken Arabic and English is mandatory.

approved Bill of Quantities (BOQ). 7- Other Job-Related Duties  Perform any additional duties related to the role as assigned by the direct manager.

review_candidates.title: Principal Reservoir Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Overview We are seeking an accomplished Principal Reservoir Engineer to join our exploration and development asset team in Tripoli, Libya. Reporting directly to the Subsurface Director in Doha, this is a senior-level individual contributor role suited for a technical authority who thrives on execution. In collaboration with your geoscience colleagues, you will take full ownership of day-to-day reservoir engineering tasks, asset modeling, and support technical JV governance. Key Responsibilities Asset Execution: Deliver day-to-day technical reservoir deliverables, including production forecasting, decline curve analysis (DCA), and asset performance optimization. Subsurface & Commercial Integration: Collaborate directly with geoscientists to integrate reservoir parameters into static and dynamic models, ensuring all technical subsurface outcomes align with project economics and commercial asset value. Numerical Simulation : Take hands-on ownership of constructing, updating, and history-matching robust dynamic reservoir models. JV Governance & Diplomacy: Act as the technical authority during Joint Venture Technical Committee Meetings (TCMs) and Operating Committee Meetings (OCMs) to secure partner alignment. Directorate Support: Provide direct technical advisory, production forecasts, and reserve evaluations to the Subsurface Director to support strategic asset decisions. Reserves Maturation: Drive resource maturation compliance in accordance with PRMS standards, collaborating closely with G&G peers. Data Integrity & Audit: Maintain absolute oversight of all reservoir data and history-matched models to ensure complete readiness for corporate or third-party audits. Full Lifecycle Engineering: Manage the complete reservoir lifecycle, spanning fluid characterization (PVT), core analysis (SCAL), and pressure transient analysis (PTA). Technology Adoption: Identify and champion the strategic adoption of new reservoir simulation technologies and workflow improvements for the asset team. Technical Mentorship: Foster knowledge sharing and technical excellence without formal administrative reporting lines. Qualifications & Requirements Education: Minimum Master of Science (MSc) in Petroleum Engineering, Reservoir Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Experience: 15+ years of hands-on, progressive experience in upstream oil & gas, with a strong background within a major or large independent operator. Regional Knowledge: Proven track record of navigating subsurface and development challenges within North Africa (prior Libya asset experience is highly advantageous). Technical Authority: Demonstrated expert-level, hands-on experience in numerical reservoir simulation, history matching, and enhanced oil recovery (EOR) projects. Commercial Literacy: Strong business and commercial acumen with demonstrated experience linking subsurface evaluations to project economics and investment decisions. Mobility: Willingness and flexibility to travel between Tripoli and asset sites as required. Software Mastery: Expert, daily proficiency in modern reservoir simulation suites (e.g., Eclipse, Navigator, Intersect, or Petrel RE). Languages: Fluency in both English and Arabic is required.

review_candidates.description: Company Overview: Moncler Group is a leading retail company dedicated to delivering exceptional products and services to our clients. With a commitment to innovation, quality, and client satisfaction, we have established ourselves as a trusted brand in the retail industry. Position Overview: The PR Specialist is responsible for executing day-to-day PR activities, including press relations, agency coordination, media monitoring, and event support. Reporting to the Communication Manager, the role works closely with the local PR agency and HQ to communicate seasonal brand messages and support editorial coverage. Reporting Line: Direct report to Communication Manager Key Responsibilities: Build and maintain positive relationships with editors, stylists, and key opinion leaders, and identify relevant editorial opportunities. Conduct seasonal press visits and product presentations to communicate key brand stories and collections. Prepare and distribute approved press materials, including press releases, product information, and images. Coordinate Korean translations and check materials for accuracy before submitting them for internal review. Coordinate responses to press inquiries and escalate corporate or sensitive requests to the Communication Manager. Support editorial coverage targets and monitor results against agreed PR KPIs. Coordinate PR sample shipments from HQ and oversee the agency’s handling of sample inventory, loans, and returns, working together to resolve any issues. Support the planning and execution of seasonal press events, including invitations, guest lists, logistics, and post-event reporting. Support all local and global event coordination. review_candidates.title: Operations Manager
review_candidates.description: Essential Duties & Responsibilities: 1. Operating Model and Governance Design, implement and maintain the cross-function operating model within the approved operating-model direction and decision rights, including the RACI, escalation paths, handover standards and interfaces between the NOC, outsourced SOC oversight, DC / Critical Facilities, integrated service desk and platform and partner teams. Line-manage the functional operations managers (NOC, SOC, DC / Critical Facilities), setting objectives and common operating standards while each retains ownership of their function. Preserve the independent security authority and escalation route of the SOC function, and the technical ownership of NOC tooling and facilities, within the common standards. Run the operational governance cadence, including daily and weekly operations reviews, major-incident and problem reviews, and corrective-action tracking to closure. Verify process compliance across the NOC, SOC and DC functions and drive corrective action for recurring gaps. Own the SLA and KPI framework, service-performance reporting and service-governance cadence. Arrange independent assurance of service performance through the approved governance route, outside the operations line, rather than self-assuring. Escalate material operational risks, decision-rights conflicts and underperformance to executive management through the approved governance route. 2. Operations Readiness and Shift Model Produce and execute the operational-readiness plan covering process, tooling, people and documentation for approval by the designated approving authority. Integrate readiness across the NOC, outsourced SOC oversight, platform, integrated service desk and critical facilities; the NOC function owns NOC build and tooling, the SOC function owns outsourced SOC governance and the DC / Critical Facilities function owns facilities. Maintain readiness gaps, owners, target dates and acceptance evidence. Define the 24x7x365 shift-model framework, staffing establishment, rota standard, leave-planning rules and recruitment pipeline for approval, and approve each function's shift pattern against it; each functional manager proposes and operates their own pattern and roster within the framework. 3. ITSM and Service Coordination Define and implement the cross-service ITSM processes for incident, service request, change, problem and knowledge management that all operational functions work against; functional managers configure tooling and runbooks to these processes. Command major incidents and coordinate cross-functional service restoration, holding the approved acknowledgement targets of 15 minutes for Critical, 30 minutes for Major and 60 minutes for Minor incidents. Manage progress notification during incidents, every 30 minutes for Critical, every 2 hours for Major and every 6 hours for Minor and deliver reason-for-outage and root-cause reports within the contractual window. Own the cross-service escalation model and resolver responsibilities and ensure operational records support service reporting and assurance. Act as duty manager within the 24x7x365 escalation roster for major incidents. 4. Service Performance and Workforce Control Operate day-to-day service-performance monitoring against the SLA and KPI framework, including measurement method, reporting cadence and exclusions. Consolidate and validate the operational data supplied by the NOC, SOC and DC functions and issue the customer-facing service report. Set roster coverage, leave-planning and performance standards across the integrated service desk, NOC and SOC shift teams, monitored through the functional managers. Own the competency framework, onboarding and training standards and consolidated competency records for the operations establishment; functional managers deliver and validate function-specific competency. Drive corrective actions for recurring service or workforce gaps. 5. Operations Transition and Stabilisation Maintain the integrated operations transition plan, runbook and SOP register, owners and acceptance dates across all operational functions. Verify that runbooks, SOPs and knowledge transfer produced by the functional managers are complete and signed off before service activation. Coordinate shadowing, reverse shadowing, training and competency validation for the operations establishment. Lead operations service transition and stabilisation, escalating unresolved gaps to executive management until exit criteria are met. Education, Skills and Experience Requirements: Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline. ITIL and relevant network, monitoring or infrastructure certification is strongly preferred and certification in service operations, cloud, monitoring or business is advantageous. Minimum 8 years managing ICT, cloud or managed-services operations, including direct responsibility for a 24x7x365 shift team and line management of functional managers. Proven experience running 24x7x365 operations with ITSM, monitoring and AIOps tooling against contractual SLAs Experience designing and governing a cross-functional operating model, RACI, SLA / KPI framework and operational governance cadence. Strong ITSM, incident, problem, change and major-incident command capability. Experience in shift-model design, rostering and operational readiness for a newly launched service. Proven transition of partner-supported services into stable internal operations. Maintain operating-model, RACI, escalation, SLA / KPI framework, ITSM, major-incident, roster, competency, service-performance, readiness, runbook and transition records.

review_candidates.title: National Project Officer (Livelihoods)
review_candidates.description: Job Description Introduction Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants. IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move. IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration Applications are welcome from internal and external candidates. For all IOM vacancies, applications from qualified and eligible first-tier candidates are considered before those of qualified and eligible second-tier candidates in the selection process. For the purpose of this vacancy, internal and internal-equivalent candidates as well as external women candidates are considered as first-tier candidates. Organizational Context and Scope Under the overall supervision of the Head of Division, PRSD and the direct supervision of the Livelihoods Senior Programme Coordinator, the Livelihoods National Project Officer will lead the technical teams implementing the Individual Livelihoods Assistance (ILA) programme, the Employment for Public Works (EPW) programme, the Graduation Approach (GA) programmes. The Livelihoods National Project Officer closely coordinates with the Operations teams for implementation activities. Responsibilities Coordinate the overall technical implementation of the project including the oversight of the financial, logistical, administrative and technical aspects in accordance with IOM’s policies, practices and global standards as well as relevant requirements, guidelines and grant agreements. Monitor project implementation according to the work plan; document and evaluate results; identify the causes of deviations and bottlenecks and recommend and implement corrective actions. Promote and contribute to the integration and mainstreaming of gender, protection, human rights and other pertinent cross-cutting issues into programme implementation. Develop monitoring, evaluation, and reporting tools. Contribute to information management including awareness raising and visibility, press releases, website updates and other relevant information-sharing materials. Identify potential areas for project development and contribute to the development of new projects by selecting and summarizing background information, assessing the local context and drafting segments of project proposals. Participate in the development and adjustment of methodologies, contingency plans, approaches and standard operations procedures to respond to emerging challenges in the county through a consultative process with other relevant parties in the office. Coordinate the elaboration and dissemination of reports for donors, government and other relevant stakeholders ensuring timely submission and compliance with donor and IOM requirements. Liaise and coordinate with government entities, implementing partners, United Nation agencies, civil society, donors and other stakeholders. Plan, develop, organize and deliver capacity building activities to build capacity of staff, partners, government officials, and other humanitarian actors. Participate in relevant conferences, working groups, workshops, steering committees, working groups, and other forums Supervise, train, and guide project staff. Undertake duty travel as required related to project implementation and monitoring. Perform other related duties as assigned. Qualifications Required Qualifications and Experience Education Bachelor’s degree in Political or Social Sciences, International Relations, Development Studies, Migration Studies, Human Rights, Law or related fields from an accredited academic institution with four years of relevant professional experience; or, Master’s degree in the above-mentioned fields with two years of relevant professional experience; Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database. Experience Prior work experience leading livelihoods initiatives for international humanitarian organizations, non-government or government institutions/organisations; Experience in liaising with governmental authorities, national/international institutions, United Nations agencies and non-governmental organizations; Experience in working with migrants, refugees, internally displaced persons, victims of trafficking and other vulnerable groups; and, Prior work experience with international humanitarian organizations, non-government or government institutions/organization in a multi-cultural setting is an advantage. Skills In depth knowledge of the broad range of livelihoods related subject areas dealt with by the Organization; and, Knowledge of Governmental livelihoods programmes Knowledge of financial rules and regulations. Languages All IOM staff members in all categories are required to be fluent in one of the IOM's official languages (English, French, Spanish). For this position, Fluency in English is required Arabic and Kurdish are advantage Languages Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments. Required Competencies IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link . Competencies will be assessed during the selection process. Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values: Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion. Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct. Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges. Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance. Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated. Core Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 2 Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results. Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes. Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate. Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work. Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way. Managerial Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 2, if with direct reports Leadership: Provides a clear sense of direction, leads by example and demonstrates the ability to carry out the Organization’s vision. Assists others to realize and develop their leadership and professional potential. Empowering others: Creates an enabling environment where staff can contribute their best and develop their potential. Building Trust: Promotes shared values and creates an atmosphere of trust and honesty. Strategic thinking and vision: Works strategically to realize the Organization’s goals and communicates a clear strategic direction. Humility: Leads with humility and shows openness to acknowledging own shortcomings. Notes Please refer to this link for guidance on IOM Job Category. Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation. This selection process may be used to staff similar positions in various duty stations. Recommended candidates will remain eligible to be appointed in a similar position for a period of 24 months. Appointment will be subject to certification that the candidate is medically fit for appointment, accreditation, any residency or visa requirements, security clearances. IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination based on gender, nationality, age, race, sexual orientation, religious or ethnic background or disabilities. IOM does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process (application, interview, processing, training or other fee). IOM does not request any information related to bank accounts. IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM e-Recruitment system (for internal candidates link here ). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application. No late applications will be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. For further information and other job postings, you are welcome to visit our website: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies

review_candidates.description: Eurofins is an international network of independent life sciences companies, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate. The Eurofins network is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across its companies around the world. Job Description Master Data & Data Quality Create, maintain and enrich master data records. Ensure data quality, consistency and compliance with global standards. Analyze data quality trends and identify areas requiring improvement. Support data governance initiatives and standardization projects. Business Analysis & Project Support Organize and lead meetings with business stakeholders worldwide. Gather, document and challenge business requirements. Translate business needs into practical solutions and process improvements. Coordinate activities with purchasing, finance, laboratories and other stakeholders. Independently manage smaller improvement projects from idea to implementation. Prepare business cases and recommendations based on data analysis. Reporting & Analytics Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports. Use Power Query and Excel to transform and analyze datasets. Identify trends, inefficiencies and improvement opportunities. Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders and management. AI & Automation Leverage AI and Large Language Models (Copilot, ChatGPT or similar tools) to improve productivity and data quality. Identify opportunities for automation and process simplification. Participate in implementation of AI-driven solutions supporting Master Data operations. Qualifications Bachelor’s, Engineering, or Master’s degree Minimum 6 months of relevant experience working with data Intermediate knowledge of Excel English at a minimum B2 level, with the ability to conduct meetings with stakeholders Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a problem-solving attitude Experience working with ERP systems would be an advantage Customer-service mindset Familiarity with Power BI, Power Query, and/or VBA would be an asset Additional Information We support your development! As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Eurofins network of companies believes in strength and innovation through diversity. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique. Find out more on our Careers page: https://careers.eurofins.com/ Company description : Eurofins Scientific is an international network of independent life sciences companies, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. In under 40 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 employees across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of over 950 laboratories in over 1,000 independent companies across 57 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. The Eurofins network generated EUR 7.296 billion revenues in FY 2025, and has been one of the fastest growing listed European companies for almost three decades.
